from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """Financial liability data extracted from a single company's financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company reporting this filing")
    liability_line_item: str | None = Field(description="The exact name of the liability line item found (e.g., 'Accounts payable', 'Accounts payable and accrued liabilities')")
    liability_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the liability")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount if applicable (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions')")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The period covered by the financial statement")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    liability_records: list[CompanyLiabilityRecord]
